subject: TideBank telemetry spike — IRP summary request and evidence portal setup
messages:
From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@tidebank.com>
To: dylan_brooks@redwood.ai
Cc: security@tidebank.com
Date: Tue, 5 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Unusual token billing spike / asking for IRP and upload flow

Hi Dylan,

Quick heads up — we saw an unexplained spike in API token usage tied to a small set of accounts this morning (around 03:50 UTC). Our SREs captured a telemetry snapshot and some alert logs; attached two files for your triage.

TideBank requires a formal incident summary and an outline of how Redwood will preserve and hand over relevant telemetry for our SOC 2 review. Can you confirm:
- Whether Redwood has an incident response playbook we can reference (preferably a redacted version suitable for sharing with our audit team)
- The secure upload process for evidence and any retention window (we need to keep artifacts for 90 days)
- Who our single POC should be for any follow-up questions (also for SIG/CAIQ evidence mapping)

We'd like to get a short IRP summary today and a plan for evidence transfer by EOD tomorrow if possible.

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Chen
Head of Security Operations, TideBank

Attachments: tidebank-alerts-20280605.log, initial-telemetry-snapshot.tgz

From: dylan_brooks@redwood.ai <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@tidebank.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 5 Jun 2028 09:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Unusual token billing spike / asking for IRP and upload flow

Alex — thanks for the heads up and for the artifacts. We're triaging immediately.

Short answers up front:
- We do have a customer-facing IR playbook (redacted) we can share; it includes preservation steps, evidence categories, and a standard timeline we follow for SOC 2 matters.
- We have a secure evidence portal for uploads (link below). We keep evidence in a restricted bucket; default retention is 180 days but we can set a 90-day retention for this exchange and provide a retention confirmation statement.
- I'll be your POC for operational coordination today. Marissa (Security Ops) will handle artifact intake and redaction guidance; Karthik will map artifacts to SIG/CAIQ controls.

Plan:
1) I'll send the redacted IR playbook and a short incident summary template within 60 minutes.
2) Marissa will open a portal intake ticket and provide instructions for the upload (SFTP + portal link; portal preferred).
3) Karthik will start a SIG/CAIQ gap check against the artifacts you provided once they're uploaded.

If TideBank prefers we open a dedicated retainer for forensic export assistance, say so and I'll route to finance/CS. Otherwise our standard intake process should suffice.

Link to portal (secure): https://secure-upload.redwood.ai/portal/tidebank-123

—Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Sr. Solutions Engineer, Incident Response Liaison
Redwood Inference

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@tidebank.com>, dylan_brooks@redwood.ai
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 5 Jun 2028 11:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Intake instructions and evidence checklist (TideBank)

Alex / Dylan — looping in operational steps.

Alex, thanks for the early artifacts. For the intake please:
- Upload the two files you already have to the portal link Dylan shared. Use the "Add context" field to list affected project IDs and sample request IDs.
- If you have any additional logs (auth logs, token issuance traces, backend request IDs for the spike window), include them as separate uploads and mark them as "high priority."

Minimal evidence checklist we need to map to SIG/SOC2:
- Auth logs (token create/refresh/revoke) for the window (CSV preferred)
- Request traces (gateway + application) for sampled requests
- SAML/OIDC assertions if any orgs used SSO in that window
- Any related alerts from your WAF or CDN (screenshots acceptable for WAF rules)
- A short description of your business impact (estimated affected users / billing impact)

Retention & access:
- We will assign a temporary read-only ACL to TideBank's security@tidebank.com group for the portal folder. Access will expire in 90 days unless you request an extension.
- We will produce a retention confirmation statement in PDF after the upload completes.

Redaction guidance:
- PII must be redacted unless you require full logs for forensic analysis; if so, we can coordinate a secure SFTP handoff and an NDA amendment.
- For SOC 2 mapping, pseudonymized IDs are typically sufficient. Karthik can advise on specific control mapping.

I'll open intake ticket: RI-INC-8429 and post the upload checklist there.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Security Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment: intake-checklist-template.docx

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@tidebank.com>, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, dylan_brooks@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 5 Jun 2028 14:28:00 -07:00
Subject: SIG/CAIQ mapping approach and next steps

Alex / team — quick note on mapping and timelines.

Objective: map provided artifacts to SIG/CAIQ control families and identify whether additional evidence is required for TideBank's auditor.

Workflow I will follow once files are in the portal:
1) Ingest logs and run the automated SIG matcher to find direct control correlations (authorization, audit logging, change management, identity).
2) Flag any control gaps and mark whether they require alternative evidence (e.g., runbook excerpts, architectural diagrams, vendor attestations).
3) Produce a single, redacted mapping spreadsheet and a short summary report (2 pages) for TideBank's auditor.

Estimated timeline: 24 hours for initial mapping after upload; 48 hours for the redacted deliverable. If you need a faster turnaround we can scope a forensic retainer (estimated 8–12 engineer-hours).

Temporary access: please confirm you accept the 90-day temp ACL. We will also drop an access log extract into the portal showing who downloaded artifacts.

If TideBank can provide a single example request ID (from the spike window) it will speed correlation.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Applied Security Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@tidebank.com>
To: dylan_brooks@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 6 Jun 2028 14:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Unusual token billing spike / asking for IRP and upload flow

Thanks all — brief update from our side.

We uploaded the requested artifacts to the portal (same filenames as attached earlier) and added a short impact statement in the context field. We accepted the 90-day ACL. Upload link for your reference: https://secure-upload.redwood.ai/portal/tidebank-123/folder/abc123

We also included one sample request ID: req_20280605_9f3b. Please let us know when you've confirmed ingest (or if you need the full SFTP package).

Alex
Alex Chen
Head of Security Operations, TideBank
